subtests.name: e.style['position-anchor'] = "normal" should set the property value
e.style['position-anchor'] = "none" should set the property value
e.style['position-anchor'] = "auto" should set the property value
e.style['position-anchor'] = "--foo" should set the property value
e.style['position-anchor'] = "foo-bar" should not set the property value
e.style['position-anchor'] = "--foo --bar" should not set the property value
e.style['position-anchor'] = "--foo, --bar" should not set the property value
e.style['position-anchor'] = "100px" should not set the property value
e.style['position-anchor'] = "100%" should not set the property value
